registration.statement: A metal cluster is one finite complete support of at least two distinct metal centres connected by the generated cluster-relation graph. Direct metal bonds, bridging-ligand paths and held grouping relations are separate support classes; direct or bridging bonding may be structurally absent without destroying a connected cluster. Each class is counted positively or retained as EmptyOne, and a fresh attached centre preserves connectivity.
registration.title: Exact finite connected metal-cluster and metal-bonding law
